h1: Custom Hanes Putty for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Hanes putty in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for corporate events, giveaways, and promotional use. Get started today!
introHtml: Hanes putty offers a soft, pliable texture that makes it ideal for stress relief in the workplace. Unlike standard promotional putty, Hanes branding ensures consistent quality and a non-sticky feel. Perfect for trade shows, employee wellness kits, or safety incentives, custom Hanes putty can be imprinted with your logo using pad printing or screen printing. Choose from a range of colors to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom Hanes putty with company logo in assorted colors for promotional giveaways
